title: Deputy appointments and oaths filed for the Office of the Sheriff

communications.communication:
To: Office of the County Clerk-Recorder, County of Santa Clara
Re: California Public Records Act request: Deputy appointments and oaths filed for the Office of the Sheriff

Under the California Public Records Act (Gov. Code, § 7920.000 et seq.), I request copies of the following records. Records of this kind are filed with the County Clerk under Government Code section 24102, subdivision (a), which provides that an appointee "shall not act as deputy until" a "written appointment by the deputy's principal is filed with the county clerk" and the deputy "has taken the oath of office." See also Government Code section 1363, subdivision (a)(2), which requires the oaths of officers elected or appointed for any county to be filed in the office of the county clerk.

1. Special and limited-duty deputies: Any written appointment, and any oath of office, filed by or for the Office of the Sheriff, regardless of when filed, for an appointment in effect at any time from January 1, 2025 through the date your search is completed, whose filing designates the person as a special deputy sheriff or states that the person's duties or authority are limited (for example, to parking enforcement).
2. Stanford-related appointments: Any written appointment, and any oath of office, filed by or for the Office of the Sheriff, regardless of when filed, for an appointment in effect at any time from January 1, 2025 through the date your search is completed, whose filing identifies an assignment to Stanford University, or employment by Stanford University or SP Plus Corporation (also known as SP+). It also includes any such appointment or oath for a Santa Clara County Reserve Deputy Sheriff whose filing names Stanford University or refers to the 2007 Memorandum of Understanding Regarding Police Services between the County of Santa Clara and Stanford University (or any successor or amended agreement).
3. Index: Any index, log, register, or list maintained by the County Clerk of the appointments described in items 1 and 2. If the index cannot be limited to those appointments, the existing index entries or pages for deputy appointments filed by or for the Office of the Sheriff on or after January 1, 2015, as kept in the ordinary course, are acceptable; I do not ask you to determine which appointments were in effect. An existing index is responsive whatever fields it contains; I do not ask you to create or reformat one.
4. Revocations and changes: For appointments described in item 1 or 2, and for the period from January 1, 2025 through the date your search is completed: any revocation filed under Government Code section 24102, subdivision (c); any new appointment filed because of a change in name, delegated authority, or department; and any record maintained under Government Code section 24102, subdivision (b), indicating whether a person required to file a new appointment or new oath of office has complied (which that subdivision makes a public record subject to disclosure under the Act).

For items 1 and 2, an appointment is "in effect" unless a revocation of it was filed before January 1, 2025. I do not ask you to determine an appointment's status in any other way. If filings made before January 1, 2015 are not readily searchable, please first produce responsive filings made on or after January 1, 2015, and tell me how earlier filings are kept so that we can discuss them.

Personal information redaction: Please redact home addresses, signatures, and other personal details, such as dates of birth and personal telephone numbers or email addresses. The redacted copies should still show each person's name; title or designation; employer or assignment, where stated; dates of appointment, oath, filing, and any revocation; and the stated scope of authority. Peace officers' names and employing agencies are generally not confidential and are subject to disclosure under the Act. (Commission on Peace Officer Standards & Training v. Superior Court (2007) 42 Cal.4th 278, 284.)

Format and fees: Please provide records held in electronic form in that format (Gov. Code, § 7922.570); for paper records, scanned copies by email or download link are preferred. Fees for copies are limited to the direct cost of duplication or any applicable statutory fee (Gov. Code, § 7922.530, subd. (a)). Please contact me before incurring fees over $25, and tell me the estimated page count at that time.

Scope: I have tried to describe these records so that each item reasonably describes an identifiable record or records (Gov. Code, § 7922.530, subd. (a)). The Act does not permit limiting access based on the purpose of a request (Gov. Code, § 7921.300). If any item is unclear or broader than your filing system allows, please contact me so I can narrow it (Gov. Code, § 7922.600).

Response: Within 10 days of receipt, please notify me whether you have disclosable records and the estimated date they will be available (Gov. Code, § 7922.535, subd. (a)). If any record is withheld in whole or in part:

- please identify it, or the category of records, and the exemption claimed (Gov. Code, § 7922.000);
- please produce all reasonably segregable portions (Gov. Code, § 7922.525, subd. (b)); and
- please state the names and titles of the persons responsible for the denial (Gov. Code, § 7922.540, subd. (b)).

Thank you,
Anthony Tan

title: SNAP and Medicaid receipients by employer (Northrop Grumman)

communications.subject: Government Records Access and Management Act Request: SNAP and Medicaid receipients by employer (Northrop Grumman)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Government Records Access and Management Act, I hereby request the following records:

Any records that contain the aggregate number of unique individuals who list Northrop Grumman as their employer and have received SNAP or Medicaid benefits in the years 2025 or 2026.

The employer name may also be listed as Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation, Northrop Grumman Innovation Systems, Northrop Grumman Space Systems, and Northrop Grumman Propulsion Systems.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Taylor Barnes
